access.code_pr6_pr10_test: never read their manifests, scores or waveforms during development; recompute PR6 eligibility predicate only on authorized CODE patient keys and distinguish eligibility from verified membership
access.chapman: sealed train and validation, already exposed; source diagnostics only
access.cpsc: sealed train, masked SB/STACH; no certified patient IDs; score source-excluded fits on this bank only as transfer diagnostics, never a fitted model as a held-out CPSC result
access.mimic: existing train-only masked SSL checkpoint; no diagnostic labels or new download
access.publication: aggregates and whole-artifact hashes only; no signals, identifiers, individual scores or checkpoints

diagnosis.qrs: WFDB XQRS on standardized lead II and V2 rescaled to a fixed detector amplitude, matched within 80 ms; require four detections and at least 75 percent cross-lead agreement for HR/RR statistics; signal proxy, not manually adjudicated
diagnosis.noise_proxy: lead-II Welch relative power at 15-45 Hz; no noise adjudication
diagnosis.pr_policy: NOT_MEASURED without a validated P-onset and QRS-onset contract; never assign a PR interval from a speculative peak
diagnosis.frontier: all unique raw scores plus the all-negative operating point, no test

calibration.method_selection: 3 grouped inner folds of calibration; minimize macro Brier, then ECE; prefer simpler mapping within 0.0002 macro Brier; isotonic requires at least 35 positives and 35 negatives in every fitting fold for its endpoint, otherwise use Platt
calibration.threshold_selection: search native-score frontier using calibration only; among feasible thresholds maximize F1, then PPV, then specificity; infeasible fallback minimizes summed guard deficit before F1 and is labeled infeasible
calibration.reference: on the same calibration or reporting rows, compare AFIB to better released sensitivity, 1AVB to better released PPV, SB/RBBB/STACH to the incumbent fixed operating point

training.full_gate: execute one full fit if the incumbent calibration frontier cannot satisfy all guards or the best partial arm fails to improve validation macro AP by 0.02
training.ranking: validation macro AP first, then mean guard-endpoint AP, then run name; no calibration labels for model selection
training.repeat: top CODE-only arm and top multisource or SSL arm over the remaining two seeds, subject to the frozen cap; family selection by mean validation macro AP and representative by median seed
training.stop: no retry for results, only logged infrastructure repair; no experiment once the frozen fit or allocation cap is reached

requires: verified patient and signal overlap controls
